    tickets = []
    # Total coupons spent

    # Current time

    for Z, T in trips:

        while tickets and tickets[0][0] < T:

        if tickets and tickets[0][1] >= Z:

        A = max(0, Z - 1)
        B = min(10, Z + 1)
        
        # Calculate the cost of the new ticket
        cost = 2 + abs(A - B)
        total_coupons += cost
        
        # Add the new ticket to the priority queue
        expiration_time = T + 10000
        heapq.heappush(tickets, (expiration_time, B))
    
    return total_coupons
